name: What financial losses can be claimed after a car accident injury?

mainEntity.name: What financial losses can be claimed after a car accident injury?

acceptedAnswer.text: Injured claimants can seek damages for lost wages, missed work days, and diminished earning capacity along with out-of-pocket expenses and property damage.mitchelllawcorp​
